vetSays.line: A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Pasquale, Wilhelm, Betty and Craig met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Pasquale, Wilhelm, Craig are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
